lessons.title: Hello and Goodbye

items.example: 'Buenas noches, ¿cómo fue tu día?','Good evening, how was your day?'
items.exampleMeaning: Good evening, how was your day?

items.example: '¿Cómo estás? Estoy bien.','How are you? I am fine.'
items.exampleMeaning: How are you? I am fine.

lessons.tip: Use 'Hola' at any time of day. 'Buenos días' is used in the morning, 'Buenas tardes' in the afternoon, and 'Buenas noches' in the evening.

scenario.partnerRole: A is a friendly person meeting you.
scenario.brief: A greets you and asks your name and where you are from. Respond politely.
scenario.goal: You should introduce yourself and say where you are from.

lessons.title: Using 'To Be'

items.example: '¿Eres de aquí? Soy de México.','Are you from here? I am from Mexico.'
items.exampleMeaning: Are you from here? I am from Mexico.

lessons.tip: Use 'soy' for yourself, 'eres' for friends, and 'es' for others. 'Son' is for plural subjects.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And you, where are you from?

scenario.partnerRole: A is curious about your background.
scenario.learnerRole: You are a student from Mexico.
scenario.brief: A asks you if you are from here and about your studies. Respond with your information.
scenario.goal: You should explain where you are from and your student status.

lessons.title: Talking About Yourself

items.example: 'Vivo en la ciudad.','I live in the city.'
'Tengo veinte años.','I am twenty years old.'
'¿Cuántos años tienes? Tengo veinte años.','How old are you? I am twenty years old.'
items.exampleMeaning: How old are you? I am twenty years old.

lessons.tip: Use 'Me llamo' to introduce your name. 'Tengo' is used for age and possessions.

scenario.partnerRole: A wants to learn more about you.
scenario.learnerRole: You are Alex, living in Mexico.
scenario.brief: A asks about your age, name, and where you live. Respond with your details.
scenario.goal: You should share your name, age, and where you live.

lessons.title: Where Are You From?

items.example: '¿De dónde eres? Soy de Perú.','Where are you from? I am from Peru.'
items.exampleMeaning: Where are you from? I am from Peru.

items.example: 'Soy de Brasil. ¿Y tú?','I am from Brazil. And you?'
items.exampleMeaning: I am from Brazil. And you?

items.example: 'Sí, soy de Chile.','Yes, I am from Chile.'
'No, no soy de México.','No, I am not from Mexico.'
items.exampleMeaning: No, I am not from Mexico.

lessons.tip: Use '¿De dónde eres?' to ask someone where they are from. You can respond with 'Soy de ...'.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: No, I am not from here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: And you, where are you from?

scenario.partnerRole: A is curious about your origin.
scenario.learnerRole: You are from Colombia or Peru.
scenario.brief: A asks where you are from and if you are from there. Respond with your origin.
scenario.goal: You should explain where you are from.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: I am fine, thank you. And you?

scenario.learnerRole: You are María from Argentina, twenty years old.
scenario.brief: A will ask you about your name, where you are from, and your age. Respond with your details.
scenario.goal: You should introduce yourself and answer all questions.
